title: Costa Rica's biodiversity: volcanoes, cloud forests and rainforests
goal: Describe the nature of Costa Rica and put the key piece in the spotlight, with cleft sentences.
grammar: cleft sentences: Fue en… donde…, Lo que… es… (review)

sections.title: Costa Rica's biodiversity: volcanoes, cloud forests and rainforests
body: In this lesson you read about the nature of Costa Rica: its volcanoes, its cloud forest of Monteverde, Corcovado and the turtles of Tortuguero. The text is in Spanish; the screens and instructions are in English.
The grammar is the one you know for putting one piece in the spotlight: *Fue en Monteverde donde…*, *Lo que más sorprende es…*.

items: I can put a place, a time or an idea in the spotlight with *Fue… donde / cuando* and *Lo que… es…*.
I can say where the cloud forest, the rainforest and the turtle beaches of Costa Rica are.
I can explain why such a small country has so many species.
